Commentary.Commentary: Review time! An appeal for lbw! Andile Phehlukwayo is the man in question. Ultra Edge shows there is no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that it is three reds.
We are back for the chase! The Pakistan openers, Rizwan and Azam are out in the middle. Linde to begin. Here we go...

The wicket is flat, the boundaries are not that big, this is a high scoring ground so the chase is surely on. Pakistan though will have to bat really well and they will be relying a lot on their top order. South Africa on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this after the performance they had in the last game with the ball. The second essay could be an exciting one.

The Pakistan bowlers took a real pounding! Everyone bowler went for runs. Nawaz though was the pick. Hasan Ali came back well in the end. Shaheen had an off day but overall, they will be a tad disappointed with where they stand in the game at the moment.

After being inserted, the openers took the attack to the bowlers and managed to get the hosts off to a flier. The two laid the foundation with both scoring half tons. Linde then came in and kept the momentum going. However, once he and Malan fell, wickets kept falling at regular intervals and the scoring also got a little slow. Rassie though, with some meaty blows in the end, ensured his side finished over the 200-run mark.

End of a brilliant batting performance by South Africa! Yes, they will be a little disappointed as at one stage they could have easily got to 220 but they will not mind and will surely be the happier side heading into the break.

OUT! LBW! Afridi finishes the innings with a wicket! Full on middle, Phehlukwayo looks to play the reverse scoop but misses it and gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals for lbw and the umpire raises his finger. Phehlukwayo reviews it. Ultra Edge shows there is no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that it is three reds. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH WITH 203/5!

DROPPED! Full delivery on middle, Phehlukwayo lofts it over mid-wicket but does not get the distance on it. It goes towards the fielder where Asif Ali tries to take the catch but it falls short of him. Two runs taken.

Full on middle, Phehlukwayo looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a leg bye.

Full delivery on middle, van der Dussen flicks it through square leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Phehlukwayo slogs it through mid-wicket for a couple. 13 runs from the over!

Full delivery on off, Phehlukwayo pushes it towards covers for a single.
Short delivery on middle, van der Dussen pulls it through square leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle, van der Dussen flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen take a couple.

Length ball outside off, Rassie punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full delivery outside off, van der Dussen drives it through point for a boundary.
Full on middle, Phehlukwayo looks to push but gets an inside edge. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen cross ends.
Full delivery on off, van der Dussen lofts it over covers for a run.
SIX! That is hammered! Back of a length on middle, van der Dussen lofts it over square leg for a biggie.
Low full toss on middle, van der Dussen flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Shaheen Afridi is back on.
A single to end the over! So a really good comeback by Hasan Ali! FUller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A short one, it is pulled through square leg for one.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the next batsman in.

OUT! DRAGS IT ON! This is full and outside off, a yorker almost. Klaasen looks to hit it through the off side but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. The drop does not cost a lot and Pakistan managing to pick up wickets at regular intervals now.
A slower one, back of the hand delivery. Klaasen moves across and tries to paddle but it hits the flap of the pad and goes to the keeper.
Two! On middle, it is a full toss, it is worked through mid-wicket for two.
FOUR! Slapped over! Not a good start by Hasan Ali yet again! Shorter and it is a slower one. Klaasen waits for it and then slaps it over the mid off fielder for a boundary.

Full toss outside off, Rassie punches it through covers. The fielder in the deep dives and does well to stop it. He throws it to the keeper where Rizwan takes the bails off. Replays show that van der Dussen's dive saved him. The batsmen get two runs.
Length delivery on off, Klaasen smashes it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Low full toss on middle, Klaasen plays a paddle sweep over short fine leg for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, van der Dussen pushes it towards covers for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Klaasen pushes it through mid on for a run.
Full on middle, van der Dussen flicks it through square leg for a single.
Haris Rauf is back on.

Dropped! That should have been taken! That really should have been taken and it is off the South African skipper. This could really cost Pakistan! This is angled into the pads. Klaasen looks to flick. He is early to close the face of the bat. It goes off the leading edge to the left of Nawaz who probably saw it late. He reacts late and in the end, does not hang on. Still a very good over but had he taken that, it would have been a fabulous one.
On off, Rassie pushes it towards cover for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Klaasen is off the mark too! Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Heinrich Klaasen is the new batsman in.

OUT! TAKEN! Malan is a goner now! Just what Pakistan wanted! Two new batters out there in the middle now. Nawaz gets his second. Malan looks to play the reverse sweep, not sure why as there are three fielders behind point. Also, this one is a little too full. Malan looks to get under it but the ball takes the top edge and lobs towards short third man where the catch is taken. Pakistan crawling back into the game.
Mohammad Nawaz is back on. 3-0-33-1 are his figures so far.
Outstanding over! Three runs from it and a wicket. A much-needed good over for Pakistan! Length and on off, Rassie pushes it to covers.
That is a beauty! Length and outside off, pitches and holds its line. Rassie is beaten as he tries to block.
Very full and on middle, this is hit down to long off for one more. This too is turning out to be a good over but Faheem needs to end it well. 2 balls to go.
Good length and on off, Rassie pushes it towards cover for one.
Rassie van der Dussen is the next batsman in.

OUT! TIMBER! Chops it on! Linde though has done his job but Pakistan need to keep picking wickets if they are to stem the run flow. A short one, it is on off, a slower one. Linde has struggled with this length. He is early in the stroke, it hits the inside edge and then onto the stumps.
A low full toss, it is hit down to long off for one.
SIX! The last ball spoils it completely as this one sails over the ropes! Right in the slot. Full and on middle, Linde lofts it well over the long off fence for a huge one.
This has been a really good over so far from Hasan Ali! Another slower one, it is hit down to long off for one. Can he end it well?
Just a single! Very full and on middle, this is hit down to mid off for one.
Another dot! Follows the slower bumper with a quick one! Linde looks to pull but misses.
A rare dot! Shorter and outside off, it is a slower one. Linde looks to pull but misses.
Two more! A low full toss on middle, it is lofted towards long on for a couple.
Hasan Ali is back on. 2-0-29-0 are his figures so far.

FOUR! Fifty for Malan now and it is his first in T20Is! Top innnings. Very solid and extremely fluent. Gets there with a cracking drive. Full and outside off, it is stroked through covers. No chance of stopping that. One more huge over.
Fuller and on the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Squeezed through! This is fuller and on off, Linde plays it late and gets it past point for another boundary.
Brilliant! A yorker on middle, Linde jams it back to the bowler. A rare dot. Need a lot more of these do Pakistan.
Fuller this time and on middle, it is hit down to long on for one.
FOUR! The wicket has fallen but the boundaries continue to flow! This is shorter and on middle, Malan pulls it through mid-wicket. Boundary again.
Faheem Ashraf is back on. 2-0-20-0 are his figures so far.

SIX! Linde does not waste time here! This is right in his arc, it is full and on off. He goes for it as he lofts it down the ground for a biggie over the long off fence. A wicket from it but it is a huge over.
Two to get off the mark! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
George Linde is the new batsman in.

OUT! TIMBER! There is the wicket Pakistan so desperately needed and the change to spin works. Markram's exciting innings comes to an end. He is disappointed as he walks back but he has surely done his job. He picks the wrong ball to sweep though. This is full, right up there and on middle. Sneaks under the bat and hits the middle pole. Can Pakistan build on this now?
Swept but to the man at deep square leg. Only one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed towards cover. Single.
SIX! All the way! Markram is on fire! Nawaz slows it up, bowls it full and outside off. Markram lofts it over covers and it goes all the way. Ideal start to the over.
Mohammad Nawaz is back on.
A single to end and the 100 is up at the end of the 10th over. Markram makes room and Hasan goes full and on middle, he looks to carve it but it goes off the inner half towards the leg side for one.
FOUR! WHACKED! The boundaries continue to flow! A drag down, it is on middle, Markram heaves it wide of long on. Boundary.
A short one, a slower short one. Malan looks to pull but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
A yorker now on middle, it is jammed back to the bowler. There is a check for a no ball but it is just about fine.
Follows the boundary with a single! Angled into middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Fifty for Markram! Third in a row and this one has come up in no time. He has been in brilliant touch and is making a statement here. He makes room and Hasan Ali follows him. Markram swings, it goes off the inner half down to the fine leg fence once again.
Hasan Ali is back on. 1-0-18-0 are his figures so far.

FOUR! That is a gift and it has been put away with ease! Malan moves across, covers the stumps. Faheem looks for a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss on the pads. It is whipped down to the fine leg fence again. A big over again for South Africa.
Really well bowled! Sees the batter make room and bowls it slower and well wide outside off, it is guided through covers for one.
Two again! Length and on middle, Markram swings across the line, it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket. Two taken.
FOUR! That has been superbly played in the end! This is a yorker on the legs, Markram gets his front leg out of the way and then flicks it between his legs, down to the fine leg boundary.
Another slower one, it is well outside off. Malan slaps it down to long off for one more.
Just the one! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped over cover for a single.
Low full toss on middle, Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! This one is right in the slot! A overpitch ball. It is on middle, Markram lofts it nicely over mid on. Boundary.

We are all set for the action to begin! The South African batters, Malan and Markram walk out to bat! Shaheen Afridi has the new ball in hand. Here we go...

South Africa (Playing XI) - Janneman Malan, Aiden Markram, Rassie van der Dussen (IN FOR WIHAN LUBBE), Heinrich Klaasen (WK/C), Pite van Biljon, George Linde, Andile Phehlukwayo, Sisanda Magala, Beuran Hendricks, Lizaad Williams, Tabraiz Shamsi.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman (IN FOR SHARJEEL KHAN), Mohammad Hafeez, Haider Ali, Asif Ali, Mohammad Nawaz, Faheem Ashraf, Hasan Ali, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. Pakistan win the toss and elect to field!

A thumping win for the hosts saw them level in the series in the last game. They now have momentum on their side and will be eager to carry forward it in this game and take an unassailable lead. The visitors, on the other hand, will once again want to show how good they are in this format by making it 2-1 here. The venue is a new one but we can expect another cracker of a game. Stay tuned for the toss and the teams.
